links.comparator_used: Radiologist scoring of repeated post-deployment quality control scans, versus automated image quality metrics
links.outcome: Monthly cost savings after deployment with ongoing quality control (cost analysis)
links.effect: Monthly saving of £2,636 with image quality metrics versus approximately £2,541 with radiologist evaluation of the quality control scans
links.quote: Quality control tests using image quality metrics would save radiological burden and reduce costs compared with conducting repeated image scoring by radiologists.
